note: What a place can put in front of a character. A beat is anchored to a location and is true while the character is in that location's district; the engine picks it deterministically from the day, so nothing here is a roll and nothing here is the narrator's decision. Anchored by TAG rather than by key wherever the beat is not about one specific venue, so a beat written once works in every district that has the ground for it.
capNote: How many place beats may be live at once. Two. The Life funnel scores them against rent, wounds and people like everything else, and a place that offers four things at once is a quest board.

beats.title: The water truck didn't make it today
beats.summary: The carwash is selling clean drinking water. The line runs half the block and it is not getting shorter.

beats.title: The elevator is dead again
beats.summary: The building manager wants thirty a resident toward parts. Until somebody pays, it is the stairs.

beats.title: Somebody is moving in two containers down
beats.summary: A family, by the look of the load. Half the terrace has come out to watch and nobody is offering to help.

beats.title: The reclaimers need hands
beats.summary: Somebody destroyed three of the rooftop growing beds in the night. Nobody there thinks it was random.

beats.title: Night market in the west concourse
beats.summary: One of the Fixers running the place has opened it up for the evening. Word is somebody is carrying military-grade optics.

beats.title: The queue for clean water goes round the block
beats.summary: Whatever went wrong upstream, it has not been fixed, and the people at the front got there hours ago.

beats.title: There has been a cancellation
beats.summary: Somebody with an appointment did not turn up, and somebody else is going to take the slot.

beats.title: Somebody has been stripping the place
beats.summary: Copper, mostly, and whatever else came away with it. The work is recent enough to still be going on.

beats.title: There is a toll on this street today
beats.summary: Not a robbery. A price, quoted politely, by people who are standing where you need to walk.

beats.title: The water pressure has gone again
beats.summary: Everyone on this side of the stack is carrying bottles up. Somebody says it is the pump; somebody says it is the bill.

beats.title: They are short of hands
beats.summary: Not enough people for what needs doing before dark, and they are asking anyone standing nearby.

beats.title: A container came in that nobody has papers for
beats.summary: It is sitting where it was dropped. Two people are already arguing about whose problem that makes it.

beats.title: Somebody has been asking about you in here
beats.summary: Not by name. By description, which is worse, and whoever it was did not leave one of their own.
